mei_quant: Nightly eval alert for session-prefix prompt set — a bunch of long-context cases are getting instruction-drop / truncation around 2k-2.5k tokens on the quantized dedicated build. :eyes:

mei_quant: Quick summary: baseline fp16 run passed, q4_0 run failed. Failures look like the generation abruptly ends mid-instruction (no BOS/EOS anomalies).

deploy-bot: nightly-eval v0.9.12 run_id=nb-2026-03-19-23:45:07 — model=rwd-open-13b-quant, profile=dedicated-q4_0, region=eu-west1

anna_ml: can you paste one minimal failing example + the exact generation (raw tokens)? also which commit / runtime image?

mei_quant: pasted below — this is the prompt + model output from the failed run (trimmed). note the gold expected continuation is included after "<-EXPECTED->" for context.

mei_quant: ```
PROMPT: 
"You are a helpful assistant. Read the document and answer the question. Document: <long document body of ~3.5k tokens>
Question: Summarize the section titled 'Operational routing' in 2 bullets."

MODEL OUTPUT (q4_0):
"Operational routing uses policy graphs to route requests to cheaper variants. The system maintains... [continues] 
...and falls back to the last known-good variant."

--CUT--

<-EXPECTED->
"Operational routing uses policy graphs to route requests to cheaper variants. The system maintains per-customer latency SLOs and can split traffic by region. Key behaviors: 1) fallbacks to compatible quantized variants when capacity constrained; 2) KV prefix caching retains last 8k tokens for repeated sessions."
```

mei_quant: failure obs: the q4_0 output stops after "last known-good variant." — cuts before the explicit instruction to list bullets. fp16 run produced two bullets as expected.

david_research: curious if this is KV index wrap or an allocation failure during streaming. any KV eviction logs or session-anchor switch events around that run id?

tom_sre: checking infra logs for that run now. initial glance: no OOMs, but I see repeated "kv-slot-rotation" WARN at 23:45:09 and 23:45:12 on host rwd-ded-03. attaching grep in a sec. :thinking_face:

tom_sre: ```
23:45:09 WARN kvcache: slot_rotation triggered for session s-8f3a (used_slots=64/64)
23:45:12 INFO runtime: streaming chunk closed, seq=2048, session=s-8f3a
23:45:12 WARN runtime: incomplete-kv-append for session=s-8f3a
```

anna_ml: that seq=2048 boundary matches where outputs cut. sounds like a boundary bug: session anchoring or prefix stitching not applied when quant path uses smaller kv-slot size (we changed to 2k slots in q4_0 to reduce memory).

mei_quant: exactly. hypothesis: quantized kernel uses different KV slot granularity, and the stitching code assumes fp16 slot size. on slot rollover we're losing queued instruction tokens.

david_research: can we reproduce locally with the exact quant build and a forced slot size of 2k? i'll run a small harness and dump KV state transitions.

mei_quant: yes please. test case: same prompt, stream with chunk_size=256, induce session length ~2300 tokens. also compare model outputs with --no-kv-stitch flag to see if stitching is culprit.

tom_sre: spun up a repro VM and got early logs — kv rotation correlates with a rotate index mismatch (index jumps from 63 -> 0, but session offset not adjusted). looks like sequence_number wrapping wasn't compensated for when quant path toggles compacted index.

anna_ml: action items: 1) david to run bisect on the compile/runtime change that touched kv-slot-size/compact-index (assign). 2) mei to produce a minimized prompt+harness and run with --no-kv-stitch / --force-fp16-slot-size. 3) tom to collect host logs and preserve the failing run artifacts (retain for 7d).

mei_quant: I can have the harness and initial runs by EOD my time. putting a quick repro command below: 
```
./harness --model rwd-open-13b-quant --build v0.9.12 --stream --chunk-size 256 --force-session-tokens 2300 --dump-kv /tmp/kvdump
```

david_research: starting bisect now, will ping here when I hit the offending commit. if it's compile/kernel related, we may need a tiny rollback for dedicated until we patch.

tom_sre: saved logs to s3://redwood-eval/fails/1977654321/ — includes core, runtime logs, and kvdump sample.

anna_ml: thanks — please tag me when you have the commit. will coordinate a canary rollback if needed. :thumbsup:

mei_quant: thx all. will post initial harness runs + diffs when done.

deploy-bot: note: creating incident candidate ticket #IC-2026-314 for tracking (auto-detected regression threshold breached).

mei_quant: :white_check_mark:
